title: 帳號 B 的 Token 可讀取帳號 A 的筆記（BOLA / IDOR） / Account B's token can read account A's notes (BOLA / IDOR).
description: GET /users/1/notes 未綁定當前已驗證主體，持帳號 B（bob）Token 可取得帳號 A（alice）的資源。 / GET /users/1/notes is not bound to the authenticated principal; account B (bob) can read account A (alice)'s resources.

evidence_refs.note: 帳號 B Token 取得帳號 A 資源，HTTP 200 / Account B's token retrieves account A's resource with HTTP 200.

opinions.rationale: 回應主體 owner 與請求者不符，且無 403/404。 / The response owner differs from the requester, without a 403 or 404 response.
跨帳號可讀，屬 BOLA。 / Cross-account reads constitute BOLA.

review.human_decision: 確認為真，列入 P1 修復。 / Confirmed; prioritize remediation as P1.

notes: 靶場 examples/vulnapp 的已知弱點；用於驗證 G5 雙帳號 BOLA 測試。 / Known weakness in examples/vulnapp, used to validate the G5 two-account BOLA test.
